name: First Northern Community Bancorp
summary: First Northern Community Bancorp operates as the bank holding company for First Northern Bank of Dixon that provides commercial banking products and services to individuals, and small and medium sized businesses. The company offers deposit products, including demand, interest-bearing transaction, savings and money market, and non-brokered time deposits. It also provides commercial, commercial real estate, agriculture, residential mortgage, residential construction, and consumer loans.
